target_classification.A_clinical_target: PK_PROXY_ONLY — no clinical trial has established a CSF therapeutic threshold for bevacizumab via eShunt delivery
target_classification.B_preclinical_target: PRECLINICAL_TARGET — published IC50/EC50 data exist for VEGF inhibition assays
target_classification.C_pharmacodynamic_target: PHARMACODYNAMIC_TARGET — VEGF inhibition measurable; IC50 range 0.0224-0.397 mg/L
target_classification.D_in_vitro_ic50: IN_VITRO_IC50 — multiple assay formats report 0.0224-0.397 mg/L
target_classification.E_pk_proxy_only: PK_PROXY_ONLY — CSF concentration is a proxy; tissue concentration is the true target
target_classification.F_unknown: UNKNOWN — true therapeutic threshold for CNS tissue not established

bevacizumab.ceo_directive_compliance: Do NOT call 0.001 mg/mL a universal therapeutic threshold. Published data shows 0.01-2.26 mg/L in CSF and IC50 of 0.0224-0.397 mg/L. The 0.001 mg/mL (1 mg/L) used in V6 was an arbitrary modeling assumption, not a clinical target.

A_experimental_ic50_range.rationale: Published experimental inhibitory concentrations from VEGF binding assays

B_conservative_pd_target.rationale: 10× below lowest reported IC50 — conservative threshold for biological activity

C_no_threshold_relative_only.rationale: No therapeutic threshold assumed. Evaluate relative exposure improvement only. The 327% means 3.27× more drug reaches tissue — clinical relevance depends on the specific agent and indication.

oligonucleotide.target_classification: PK_PROXY_ONLY — ASO therapeutic thresholds are sequence-specific

gene_therapy_vector.published_csF_concentration: CereVasc published scAAV9 biodistribution via eShunt
gene_therapy_vector.target_classification: PK_PROXY_ONLY — gene therapy has no traditional concentration threshold; transduction efficiency is the target
gene_therapy_vector.note: CereVasc's published scAAV9 work via eShunt demonstrates biodistribution. The spatial separation architecture would increase viral vector residence time → more transduction. This is the platform value CereVasc is seeking.

small_molecule.published_csF_concentration: intrathecal methotrexate: 5-15 mg, CSF levels 0.1-1 mg/L
small_molecule.target_classification: CLINICAL_TARGET — methotrexate has established intrathecal therapeutic ranges
